nonBlockingObservations.title: The privacy mutation demonstrates one of the three documentation controls, not all three
evidence: SCOPE.md RF-3 says that making the fields public makes all three compile-fail examples compile, checked by policy-made-public.
evidence/run_d2a_checks.py:41 changes only ControlContext.policy to pub; all ControlPolicy fields remain private.

evidence/d2a-checks-r2/mutation-policy-made-public.log records 13 passing unit tests and documentation results of 2 passed / 1 failed. Only the context-reassembly example at line 953 compiled successfully; the examples at lines 931 and 945 remained compile failures.
nonBlockingObservations.recommendation: Narrow the SCOPE evidence claim to context reassembly, or add a separate mutation exposing ControlPolicy fields to demonstrate the other two examples. Record the failed documentation test in controls.json rather than leaving its failed list empty.
nonBlockingObservations.rationale: Non-blocking: the production fields and constructors are private, the examples are structurally sound on inspection, all three original compile-fail tests pass, and the recorded mutation genuinely detects the context privacy breach. The overstatement concerns the breadth of recorded evidence rather than an exposed production policy.
